_lead: this is the millennium after an endless dungeon opened in the no-man's-land between two empires: an adventurers' guild, dungeon-beast materials, magic crystals and glowing rank emblems are everyday, the east builds brass-and-steam magitech and rune-inscribed plate, the west goes from gunpowder muskets to its own electricity, so battle gear here looks like gear from a magitech dungeon-crawl fantasy JRPG, not plain medieval kit.
探井: gunpowder only on the western side, no electricity anywhere. East: the last war's grey-brown wall coats over enchanted half-plate and vambraces whose engraved rune lines still glow faint blue-white, magic crystals set in shield bosses, glowing house crests chiselled off or sewn over while the runes stay lit, knights' white kite shields left blank; upper-city folk and magitech engineers carry a rune-engraved spell-gun with a glowing crystal cartridge. West: border troops in black leather with a copper contract-number plate on the left shoulder, ember-lit black iron guards, single-shot muskets with powder flask and shot pouch. First dungeon salvage: smoked leather with pale beast-shell plates from the shallow floors as pauldrons, tough monster-hide gorgets, sanded bone spikes; brass gear joints and rune-circuit plates stripped from old kneeling war machines at elbow or knee; a faintly glowing white-stone seal at the chest, a cord tied on the wrist.
共约: gunpowder only on the western side (single-shot muskets giving way to repeaters near the end), no electricity anywhere. Dungeon materials become a trade: hardened guild leather with a mountain-copper scale plate on the left shoulder, patches of monster hide with an oily sheen, pauldrons cut from beast shell, bone bow-limbs and sinew strings; the first common enchantments, a blade that frosts or throws sparks when charged, shoulder runes that glow at night. East: no firearms, only spell-guns with a light or wind-blade rune at the muzzle; knights in old-castle mail with a polished scale clasp, white shields painted with the deepest dungeon floor they reached. West: legion badges sealed with a dark-red glowing contract sigil, riveted leather and iron with brass steam-age buckles, close-fitting bone-plate guards from the bell-tomb carvers, deep-tide blades with drainage holes.
繁荣: gunpowder only in the west (repeating muskets), electricity only in the west and only from about year 400, no neon. Rank emblems shaped as stars, campfires, wings, laurels and keys glow on the chest. East: mountain-copper trimmed and riveted mail and half-plate now within an adventurer's reach, belt-hung elemental crystal cases of fire and wind, crystal-filter breathing masks and anti-ether cloaks with a faint shimmer against magical dust storms, spell-guns everywhere at the dungeon mouth. West: black obsidian-steel plates and buttons, black insulated gauntlets, horn-city heavy plate quenched in blue volcanic flame with a blue sheen, iron-rimmed great shields with open-ring clasps, electromagnetic crossbow batteries and work-machine soldiers on the western wall. Mixed adventurer kit: crystal masks, holy purification charms, electric bedrolls and searchlights, dwarven copper tools; elves in moss-dyed leather with leaf-sewn cloaks and yew longbows, scaled folk in mail with a back vent, dark elves in close black that never rings or reflects.
深井: gunpowder only in the west, electricity only in the west, no neon. Everyone in issue gear. East: federation expedition troops in their regiment's colour, rune-inscribed plate engraved piece by piece and issued by quota, brass-rimmed indicator crystals on the breastplate, survey staff with glowing crystal styluses; purified deep-floor ether crystals set in sword spines and shield bosses with a deeper glow; mountain-copper tower shields mixed with ancient dragon-bone powder that shine bone-white; a small engraved depth seal behind the rank emblem. West: deep-expedition troops in black-and-red plate with the battalion number on the left pauldron, a battery cell strapped on the back, copper wire along the seams, horn-city great shields; electro-mechanical prosthetic arms with obsidian-steel frames, dragon-crystal joints and a humming cell; airship crews and winged sky riders in windproof short leather, safety lines and brass goggles.
黑潮: gunpowder only in the west (repeating rifles and machine cannon from about 880), electricity only in the west, no neon. A long war against monster tides, everything pieced together: auxiliary breastplates with guild-store vambraces, runes scratched by knife over the patches, a blue cloth band on the left arm, small war seals of shield, broken sword and banner that light up blue in battle, anti-ether cloaks with a water-like shimmer shared between two soldiers; officers in white steel plate with a thin gold rim and unrepaired arrow holes; storm-scorched iron heavy plate with a riveted iron door for a shield; sky-blue knight capes over scale-sewn leather. West: obsidian-steel pauldrons branded with a ring of fire, battery cells, electro-mechanical limbs on returning wounded. East: crystal cannon and rune-cut copper cannon, tripod-mounted heavy spell-guns for flying horrors. A legend carries one famous relic of their own; some prefer old iron to deep-ether armour.
垂暮: gunpowder only in the west, electricity only in the west, no neon. War surplus retired and mended into dungeon kit: boiled-leather jerkins with iron shoulder plates, sword spines inlaid with a thin humming line of ether crystal, war seals dimmed and put away while the glowing rank emblem stays on the chest, academy-issued mountain-copper standard longswords for new adventurers. Wall crews of the new machine galleries, steam gates and shield towers wear brass goggles, brass-buckled insulated gloves, tool belts and small crystal cells. The look begins to grow toward the present day: in the east a fitted dark coat with a stand collar under a slim rune-inscribed breastplate, in the west black and dark-red army coats with obsidian-steel plates and repeating rifles. Gear is still worn and carried by hand, no powered suits.
